This project answers questions such as:
- Which countries had the highest number of COVID-19 cases?
- Which countries had the highest death counts?
- What percentage of each country’s population was infected?
- What was the death percentage by country?
- Which continents had the highest death counts?
- How did global cases and deaths change over time?
- How did vaccination progress by country?
